lines.zh: 在空中缓缓飘动，如同幽灵般飘过。
lines.en: Drifts slowly through the air, like a ghostly presence.

lines.zh: 翅膀轻轻振动，发出微弱的声响。
lines.en: Wings vibrate softly, producing a faint sound.

lines.zh: 从远处飘来，无声无息。
lines.en: Crawls in from afar, without a sound.

lines.zh: 翅膀在夜风中轻轻舞动。
lines.en: Wings flutter gently in the night breeze.

lines.zh: 在黑暗中几乎看不见，只有声音透露其位置。
lines.en: Almost invisible in the dark, only its sound gives its location away.

lines.zh: 飞向玩家，试图接近。
lines.en: Flies towards the player, trying to get close.

lines.zh: 偶尔发出微弱的嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Occasionally emits a faint hiss.

lines.zh: 在夜晚的微光中飞舞。
lines.en: Flickers in the dim light of night.

lines.zh: 从远处飘来，悄悄接近。
lines.en: Creeps in from afar, silently approaching.

lines.zh: 翅膀在月光下闪烁着微光。
lines.en: Wings gleam faintly in the moonlight.

lines.zh: 沿着盐晶崖壁一路滑翔。
lines.en: It glides along the salt-crystal cliff.

lines.zh: 翅尖擦过天境的浮空石。
lines.en: Its wingtips brush the floating Aether stone.

lines.zh: 静静地停在半空中。
lines.en: Hovers quietly in mid-air.

lines.zh: 翅膀轻轻扇动，仿佛在休息。
lines.en: Wings gently flap, as if resting.

lines.zh: 静静地待在阴影里。
lines.en: Remains quietly in the shadows.

lines.zh: 静静地停在空中，注视着玩家。
lines.en: Hovers quietly in the air, watching the player.

lines.zh: 在微风中轻轻摇摆。
lines.en: Gently sways in the breeze.

lines.zh: 在空中漂浮，几乎不动。
lines.en: Floats in the air, barely moving.

lines.zh: 静静地漂浮在空中。
lines.en: Hovers quietly in the air.

lines.zh: 在微光中缓缓漂浮。
lines.en: Gently floats in the dim light.

lines.zh: 静静地待在黑暗中。
lines.en: Remains quietly in the darkness.

lines.zh: 静静地停在半空中，注视玩家。
lines.en: Hovers quietly in mid-air, watching the player.

lines.zh: 停在水晶丛上，收拢双翅。
lines.en: It folds its wings on a crystal cluster.

lines.zh: 吸一口花蜜，再扇两下翅膀。
lines.en: One sip of nectar, two beats of its wings.

lines.zh: 鳞粉在光里像细小的雪。
lines.en: Its scale dust drifts like fine snow.

lines.zh: 触角一直在探风向。
lines.en: Its antennae keep testing the wind.

lines.zh: 突然转向，注视着玩家。
lines.en: Suddenly turns, staring at the player.

lines.zh: 翅膀微微颤动，注视玩家。
lines.en: Wings tremble slightly, staring at the player.

lines.zh: 靠近玩家，试图引起注意。
lines.en: Crawls closer to the player, trying to draw attention.

lines.zh: 翅膀发出轻微的声音，注视玩家。
lines.en: Wings emit a faint sound, staring at the player.

lines.zh: 悄悄接近，观察玩家。
lines.en: Creeps closer to observe the player.

lines.zh: 翅膀振动，注视着玩家。
lines.en: Wings vibrate, staring at the player.

lines.zh: 靠近玩家，试图接近。
lines.en: Crawls closer, trying to get near.

lines.zh: 翅膀在空中轻轻振动，注视玩家。
lines.en: Wings vibrate gently in the air, staring at the player.

lines.zh: 悄悄接近，注视玩家。
lines.en: Creeps closer, staring at the player.

lines.zh: 翅膀轻轻振动，注视玩家。
lines.en: Wings vibrate gently, staring at the player.

lines.zh: 落在你的镐柄上歇脚。
lines.en: It rests on the handle of your pick.

lines.zh: 绕着你袖口打了三个转。
lines.en: It circles your cuff three times.

lines.zh: 它认得你身上的盐味。
lines.en: It knows the salt on your clothes.

lines.zh: 翅膀把你的脸映成蓝色。
lines.en: Its wings paint your face blue.

lines.zh: 它试探着碰了碰你的指尖。
lines.en: It taps your fingertip to test it.

lines.zh: 看向你，又回头看向花丛。
lines.en: It looks at you, then back at the flowers.

lines.zh: 你伸手，它就往上飘一尺。
lines.en: Reach out and it lifts a foot higher.

lines.zh: 它在你影子里找到阴凉。
lines.en: It finds the cool of your shadow.

lines.zh: 天境的蝶翅，破了个口。
lines.en: An Aether butterfly wing with a hole in it.

lines.zh: 身体疼痛！
lines.en: Body aches!

lines.zh: 触须被折了！
lines.en: Antennae broken!

lines.zh: 脚爪受伤了！
lines.en: Claws injured!

lines.zh: 感觉虚弱！
lines.en: Feeling weak!

lines.zh: 翅膀被撕裂！
lines.en: Wing torn!

lines.zh: 身体被撞击！
lines.en: Body hit!

lines.zh: 触须被割伤！
lines.en: Antennae cut!

lines.zh: 脚爪受伤严重！
lines.en: Claws severely injured!

lines.zh: 翅膀受了重伤！
lines.en: Wing severely injured!

lines.zh: 它那透明的翅膀吸引着你，你忍不住靠近。
lines.en: Its transparent wings lure you closer.

lines.zh: 它轻盈地飞过，似乎在戏弄你。
lines.en: It darts past with a mocking grace.

lines.zh: 它的触角轻轻触碰你的手，你感到一阵寒意。
lines.en: Its antennae touch your hand, sending shivers down your spine.

lines.zh: 它缓缓扇动翅膀，发出微弱的光芒。
lines.en: It flutters its wings, emitting a faint glow.

lines.zh: 那点花粉，值得我飞一趟。
lines.en: That bit of pollen is worth a flight.

lines.zh: 它在你耳边低语，声音如同夜风。
lines.en: It whispers near your ear, its voice like a night breeze.

lines.zh: 它突然消失在黑暗中，留下一缕烟雾。
lines.en: It vanishes into the darkness, leaving a trail of smoke.

lines.zh: 它飞近你的脸庞，冰冷的触感令人毛骨悚然。
lines.en: It flies close to your face, its cold touch sending shivers.

lines.zh: 它轻盈地落在你肩膀上，但你感觉到了它的邪恶。
lines.en: It lightly lands on your shoulder, but you feel its malice.

lines.zh: 它围绕着你盘旋，似乎在挑逗你的勇气。
lines.en: It circles around you, tempting your courage with its presence.

lines.zh: 你撞上了它的翅膀，感到一阵刺痛。
lines.en: You collide with its wings, feeling a sharp pain.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀划破了你的皮肤，鲜血直流。
lines.en: Its wings cut your skin, causing blood to flow freely.

lines.zh: 它猛然拍打翅膀，你被甩开好几步。
lines.en: It flaps its wings, sending you flying a few steps.

lines.zh: 你试图抓住它，但它轻盈地飞走了。
lines.en: You try to catch it, but it flies away with ease.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀打在你脸上，一阵剧痛。
lines.en: Its wings strike your face, causing intense pain.

lines.zh: 你撞上了它的翅膀，瞬间感到虚弱。
lines.en: You collide with its wings, feeling suddenly weak.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀扫过你的身体，留下一道伤痕。
lines.en: Its wings sweep across your body, leaving a mark.

lines.zh: 你试图躲避，但它敏捷地撞向你。
lines.en: You try to dodge, but it collides with you nimbly.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀击中你的胸膛，你感到胸闷。
lines.en: Its wings hit your chest, causing you to feel suffocated.

lines.zh: 你撞上了它的翅膀，感觉像是被无形之手推了一把。
lines.en: You collide with its wings, feeling pushed by an invisible hand.

lines.zh: 它寻找着伴侣，发出微弱的叫声。
lines.en: It searches for a mate, emitting a faint call.

lines.zh: 它的叫声在黑暗中回荡，寻找着同类。
lines.en: Its call echoes in the darkness, searching for a kindred spirit.

lines.zh: 它飞向光源，寻找着配偶。
lines.en: It flies toward the light, seeking a mate.

lines.zh: 它的叫声如同夜曲，吸引着同类。
lines.en: Its call is a nocturne, attracting its kind.

lines.zh: 它轻盈地飞舞，寻找着伴侣。
lines.en: It dances lightly, searching for a partner.

lines.zh: 它的叫声充满渴望，寻找着生命伴侣。
lines.en: Its call is filled with longing, searching for a life mate.

lines.zh: 它围绕着光源，寻找着配偶。
lines.en: It circles the light source, searching for a mate.

lines.zh: 它的叫声在空中回响，寻找着另一半。
lines.en: Its call resonates in the air, searching for its half.

lines.zh: 它飞向光源，渴望着与同类相遇。
lines.en: It flies toward the light, longing to meet its kind.

lines.zh: 它的叫声如同夜莺，寻找着生命之歌。
lines.en: Its call is like that of a nightingale, seeking the song of life.

lines.zh: 别碰我的翅粉，会痒。
lines.en: Do not touch my wing dust — it itches.

lines.zh: 这块盐晶，我抱着飞。
lines.en: I carry this salt crystal in my grip.

lines.zh: 寻找食物，我是必需品！
lines.en: Seek food, I'm a necessity!

lines.zh: 我的触须能感受到你！
lines.en: My antennae sense you!

lines.zh: 我的光芒能引诱你！
lines.en: My glow attracts you!

lines.zh: 我是天境的猎手！
lines.en: I am the hunter of the heavens!

lines.zh: 别试图抓住我！
lines.en: Don't try to catch me!

lines.zh: 我的毒液能让你痛苦！
lines.en: My venom causes pain!

lines.zh: 我栖息在黑暗中！
lines.en: I dwell in the darkness!

lines.zh: 我只在夜晚出现！
lines.en: I only appear at night!

lines.zh: 我已经锁定你了！
lines.en: I've got you now!

lines.zh: 你退到盐崖边，我跟着。
lines.en: You back to the salt cliff; I follow.

lines.zh: 我的蓝翅对准了你的眼。
lines.en: My blue wings aim at your eye.

lines.zh: 你的血液即将成为我的食物！
lines.en: Your blood will be my food!

lines.zh: 你手上的糖味，跑不掉。
lines.en: The sugar on your hands gives you away.

lines.zh: 现在，属于我的时刻来了！
lines.en: Now, my moment has come!

lines.zh: 你的恐惧将化为灰烬！
lines.en: Your fear will turn to ash!

lines.zh: 我将把你拖入深渊！
lines.en: I will drag you into the abyss!

lines.zh: 你的哀嚎将回荡天际！
lines.en: Your cries will echo through the heavens!

lines.zh: 今晚的蜜，就用你来换。
lines.en: Tonight I will trade you for nectar.

lines.zh: 你踩到了我停过的花。
lines.en: You stepped on the flower I rested on.

lines.zh: 你手上的糖味太明显了。
lines.en: The sugar on your hands is obvious.

lines.zh: 跟着我，那边有整片花海。
lines.en: Follow me; there's a whole field over there.

lines.zh: 你踩乱的鳞粉要你赔。
lines.en: You scattered my scale dust. Pay up.

lines.zh: 你是我今天唯一的目标。
lines.en: You're my only mark today.

lines.zh: 蓝翅一收，我停在你鼻尖前。
lines.en: Blue wings fold; I stop before your nose.

lines.zh: 我将用我的触须引导你！
lines.en: I will guide you with my antennae!

lines.zh: 我将用我的光芒指引你！
lines.en: I will guide you with my light!

lines.zh: 你的方向已经固定！
lines.en: Your direction is set!

lines.zh: 我将把你引入迷途！
lines.en: I will lead you astray!

lines.zh: 我将用我的毒液标记你！
lines.en: I will mark you with my venom!

lines.zh: 我将让你迷失方向！
lines.en: I will confuse your direction!

lines.zh: 我将引导你走向死亡！
lines.en: I will lead you to death!

lines.zh: 我将用我的力量控制你！
lines.en: I will control you with my power!

lines.zh: 我将引导你走向黑暗！
lines.en: I will lead you into darkness!

lines.zh: 我将用我的触须束缚你！
lines.en: I will bind you with my antennae!

lines.zh: 我在数你口袋里的糖。
lines.en: I'm counting the sweets in your pocket.

lines.zh: 你走到盐池边了。
lines.en: You've wandered to the salt pools.

lines.zh: 我的复眼里全是你的动作。
lines.en: My compound eyes hold every move you make.

lines.zh: 你抬手，我先飞高。
lines.en: Raise a hand and I rise first.

lines.zh: 风往哪吹，我就跟到哪。
lines.en: Wherever the wind goes, I follow.

lines.zh: 你的影子是我的地图。
lines.en: Your shadow is my map.

lines.zh: 再往前，就是水晶迷宫。
lines.en: Ahead lies the crystal maze.

lines.zh: 我绕着你画了一个圈。
lines.en: I have drawn one circle around you.

lines.zh: 它张开翅膀，向你扑来！
lines.en: It opens its wings and lunges at you!

lines.zh: 它的触角轻轻触碰你！
lines.en: Its antennae gently touch you!

lines.zh: 你感到一阵刺骨的寒意！
lines.en: A cold shiver runs down your spine!

lines.zh: 它张开巨大的翅膀，压在你身上！
lines.en: It opens its huge wings and pins you down!

lines.zh: 它的翅翼摩擦出诡异的声音！
lines.en: Its wings create a strange sound!

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着不祥的光芒！
lines.en: Its eyes glow with an ominous light!

lines.zh: 它用毒液浸透你的皮肤！
lines.en: Its venom soaks into your skin!

lines.zh: 它在你身边低飞，让你难以呼吸！
lines.en: It hovers near you, making it hard to breathe!

lines.zh: 它用尖锐的喙刺穿你的皮肤！
lines.en: Its sharp beak pierces your skin!

lines.zh: 翅粉扬起来，迷你的眼。
lines.en: Wing dust rises and fills your eyes.

lines.zh: 我用翅缘划你的手背。
lines.en: My wing edge scrapes your knuckles.

lines.zh: 撞你一下，再飘走。
lines.en: One bump, then I drift away.

lines.zh: 我的触角缠住了你。
lines.en: My antennae are caught on you.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇起的风也扎人。
lines.en: Even the wind off my wings stings.

lines.zh: 你打不着这么小的我。
lines.en: You can't hit something this small.

lines.zh: 看清了，你的破绽在这。
lines.en: There. I see where you're open.

lines.zh: 夜晚，它们从黑暗中出现！
lines.en: They emerge from the darkness at night!

lines.zh: 它们在天空中形成群集！
lines.en: They form swarms in the sky!

lines.zh: 它们在空中缓缓盘旋！
lines.en: They hover slowly in the air!

lines.zh: 它们从远处缓缓飞来！
lines.en: They fly in slowly from the distance!

lines.zh: 它们在空中划出诡异的轨迹！
lines.en: They trace strange patterns in the air!

lines.zh: 它们在黑暗中发出微弱的光芒！
lines.en: They emit faint glows in the darkness!

lines.zh: 它们聚集成一个巨大的漩涡！
lines.en: They swirl into a massive vortex!

lines.zh: 它们在空中形成诡异的形状！
lines.en: They form strange shapes in the air!

lines.zh: 它们在黑暗中缓缓移动！
lines.en: They move slowly in the darkness!

lines.zh: 它们在空中缓缓上升！
lines.en: They rise slowly through the air!

lines.zh: 水晶丛里钻出一只蓝翅。
lines.en: A blue wing unfolds from the crystals.

lines.zh: 盐风把我送上了天。
lines.en: The salt wind carried me up.

lines.zh: 迷宫顶上的光引我出来。
lines.en: Light above the maze drew me out.

lines.zh: 天境又多了一片会飞的颜色。
lines.en: One more flying color in the Aether.

lines.zh: 我从长者遗迹的花上醒来。
lines.en: I woke on a flower at the elder ruins.

lines.zh: 翅膀晒干了，我就起飞。
lines.en: My wings dried, so I took off.

lines.zh: 这一带的蜜都是我的。
lines.en: All the nectar here is mine.

lines.zh: 整群蝴蝶跟着我上来了。
lines.en: The whole flock rose with me.

lines.zh: 翅膀被烤焦了！
lines.en: My wings are singed!

lines.zh: 着了火！
lines.en: On fire!

lines.zh: 翅膀湿了，我扑腾不起来。
lines.en: Wings soaked. I can't flutter.

lines.zh: 鳞粉被炸散了！
lines.en: The blast scattered my scales!

lines.zh: 箭孔漏风，我飞得歪斜。
lines.en: The arrow hole leaks air; my flight tilts.

lines.zh: 魔法把翅上的蓝洗淡了。
lines.en: Magic washed the blue from my wings.

lines.zh: 找不到花蜜，翅膀都发沉。
lines.en: No nectar to find, and my wings grow heavy.

lines.zh: 翅膀被雷打得发黑。
lines.en: Lightning scorched my wings black.

lines.zh: 跌入虚无！
lines.en: Fell into void!
